text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, when I went to the cafeteria,
I saw Special Week eating an extra-large salad—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew... The TV said vegetables
are good for pimples, so...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Even if it's on the back of my neck, if someone sees it, they'll definitely laugh at me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I have to get completely better before the race...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*...
So it's nothing but veggies until then, huh...?

Special Week's worries about her skin breakout
seemed far from over.
